Initial release of daily-news skill — fetch, browse, and read daily news summaries and details.

- Supports querying latest or specific date news via API.
- Allows listing news by popularity, reading news details, and filtering by categories.
- Includes reply templates and user intents for seamless news interaction.
- Provides shell scripts for fetching news lists and details.
- Handles HTML content cleanup and error responses gracefully.
